methods.routes: Real command-palette navigation, isolated HUI state and real PI RPC. Inner overflow, alerts and oversized SVG diagnostics.
methods.cascade: Same HUI DOM under original styles, not independent DOM proof.
methods.originalComposer: Unmodified original private render functions and textarea controller from the hash-pinned shipped module, original Lit and WA runtimes. Matched deterministic props; no copied HUI child DOM.
methods.switch: Actual original WA control and thumb in four light/dark × off/on states.
methods.limit: Not an independent whole-app pixel diff. Fast mode is not implemented by PI; the original extra row is retained and its measured height difference recorded as an explicit adaptation.

excluded.reason: HUI native host has no original DOM equivalent; actual WA control/thumb tested separately.
